text:
Name: Terns - Subfamily Sterninae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, migratory only.
Habitat: Marshes and lakes. Nests are built near water on ground, mats
of aquatic vegetation, muskrat house.
Foods: Small fish, aquatic insects.
Name: Rock Dove (Domestic Pigeon) - Columbia livia
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: Cosmopolitan. Nests in building, bridges, cliffs, etc.
Foods: Seeds, grain, fruits, insects.
Name: Cuckoos - Family Cuculidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: Areas of thick brush; rivers, forests, willowgroves. Nest in low trees or bushes.
Foods: Insectivorous; caterpillars main food.
Name: Owls - Family Strigidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: May be found in most habit types due to their free-roaming nature. Nests found on ground, in trees, tree cavities, cliffs, rodent burrows.
Foods: Variety of animals depending on size of owl (rabbits, mice, frogs, birds, squirrels, hogs, crayfish and insect).
Miscellaneous: Beneficial to man due to their food habits.
Name: Goatsuckers - Family Caprimulgidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall.
Habitat: Generally, open areas, sparse brush. Eggs laid on bare ground or flat roofs.
Foods: Insectivorous.
Miscellaneous: Nocturnal.
Name: Swifts - Family Apodidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall winter, migratory only.
Habitat: Seen in flight almost anywhere.
Foods: Insectivorous.
Miscellaneous: Chimney and Vaux's swift probably are migratory only.
Name: Hummingbirds - Family Trocilidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, migratory only.
Habitat: Flowering plants, gardens, wooded areas, river grovers, and meadows. Nests are usually a cup-like of soft material in a shrub or tree.
Foods: Flower nectar, insects, fruit juice and tree sap. May be attracted to feeder with colored water and sugar.
Miscellaneous: Plants utilized (partial) garden flowers, sage, larkspur, bindweed, phlox, rose, milkweed, gooseberry, current and evening primrose.
